content.value: Which SQL query will display all records from table "ADDRESS" in descending order according to the lastname?

options.text: SELECT *FROM ADDRESS ORDER BY lastname ASC;
SELECT * FROM ADDRESS ORDFR BY lastname DESC;
SELECT * FROM ADDRESS SORT BY lastname DESC;
SELECT * FROM ADDRESS ORDER BY lastname;

content.value: Note: Option B contains a typo ('ORDFR'), but intended ORDER BY lastname DESC to sort records in descending order.
Why is normalization important in database design ?

options.text: It increases data redundancy, and improves storage efficiency.
It reduces data redundancy, eliminates anomalies, and improve data integrity.
It makes databases slower and harder to query

What is Normalization? Explain 2 NF.
Normalization is the systematic technique of organizing data in a database to reduce redundancy and eliminate unwanted anomalies (Insertion, Update, Deletion).

Second Normal Form (2NF):
A relation is in 2NF if it satisfies two conditions:

items: It is already in 1NF.
It has no partial dependency, meaning all non-prime attributes are fully functionally dependent on the primary key.

content.value: Write two DDL Commands and three DML Commands in SQL with Syntax.
Two DDL Commands:

items:
CREATE: Used to create database objects like tables.
Syntax: CREATE TABLE table_name (column1 datatype, column2 datatype);

DROP: Used to remove existing database structures.
Syntax: DROP TABLE table_name;

content.value: Three DML Commands:

items:
INSERT: Adds new rows of data to a table.
Syntax: INSERT INTO table_name (col1, col2) VALUES (val1, val2);

UPDATE: Modifies existing records in a table.
Syntax: UPDATE table_name SET col1 = val1 WHERE condition;

DELETE: Removes rows from a table.
Syntax: DELETE FROM table_name WHERE condition;

Write a PHP function which is commonly used to establish a connection to a MySQL database with an example.
In PHP, the function mysqli_connect() is commonly used to establish a connection to a MySQL database.

<?php
  $servername = "localhost";
  $username = "root";
  $password = "";
  $dbname = "test_db";

  // Create connection
  $conn = mysqli_connect($servername, $username, $password, $dbname);

  // Check connection
  if (!$conn) {
    die("Connection failed: " . mysqli_connect_error());
  }
  echo "Connected successfully";
?>
Write short notes on "class" and "Polymorphism" in Object Oriented programming.
Class: A class is a user-defined blueprint or template from which objects are created. It encapsulates data members and member functions into a single unit.
Polymorphism: Polymorphism means 'many forms'. It allows a single interface or method to take multiple forms depending on the underlying data type or object.
Explain Agile method of software development.
The Agile methodology is an iterative and flexible approach to software development. Key characteristics include:

items: Iterative Development: Projects are broken into short, repeatable sprints (usually 2 to 4 weeks).
Customer Collaboration: Continuous interaction with the client throughout the lifecycle.
Flexibility: Readily adapts to changing requirements at any development stage.
Continuous Feedback and Deployment: Early delivery of working functional modules.

content.value: Explain the three "Vs" of big data.
The three key Vs characterizing Big Data are:

items: Volume: The massive scale or sheer amount of data generated every second.
Velocity: The high speed at which new data is generated and collected.
Variety: The structural diversity of data types, including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.

Simplex Transmission Mode:
Data flows in only one direction (unidirectional). Example: Keyboard to CPU, Radio Broadcasting.

Full-Duplex Transmission Mode:
Data flows in both directions simultaneously (bidirectional). Example: Mobile phones, Telephone conversations.

Describe file handling modes on C. Write a C program to create and write data into a file.
File Handling Modes in C:

items: "r": Opens an existing file for reading.
"w": Opens a file for writing. Overwrites if it exists, creates if non-existent.
"a": Opens a file to append data at the end.
"r+": Opens file for both reading and writing.
"w+": Opens file for reading and writing (overwrites).
"a+": Opens file for reading and appending.
